name: The Inn at Mattei's Tavern, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This historic stagecoach stop turned luxury retreat perfectly captures Old West charm with modern sophistication in Santa Barbara's scenic Los Olivos wine country.
whats_special: Originally built in 1886 as a stagecoach inn, Mattei's Tavern served travelers along the dusty route between Los Angeles and San Francisco. The property retains its authentic Western character with original wooden floors, vintage photographs, and the historic tavern building that still anchors the property. You're staying in the heart of Santa Ynez Valley, surrounded by over 120 world-class wineries including Firestone and Fess Parker.
pro_tip: Book the Ghost Room (Room 6) - it's rumored to be haunted by Felix Mattei himself, and locals swear they've heard footsteps in the hallway. Whether you believe in ghosts or not, it's the most historically significant room on property.
dont_miss: The original tavern's bar where you can sip cocktails in the exact spot where stagecoach passengers once warmed up by the fireplace. Take the complimentary wine shuttle to nearby Rideau Vineyard - it's family-owned and offers some of the valley's most intimate tastings just minutes from your room.
pros: Historic 1886 stagecoach stop with authentic Western charm and character
Luxurious Auberge Collection property with premium amenities and service
Scenic Santa Ynez Valley location surrounded by vineyards and rolling hills
Award-winning dining with farm-to-table cuisine and local wine program
cons: Remote location requires driving to reach nearby attractions
Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
